scenario.name: Percentage-off-product promotion reaches a completed order
scenario.setup: A fictional product 'EXAMPLE-LANTERN' priced at $80.00 and an automatic 25% Percentage Off Product promotion targeting it. A guest buys one unit.

requirements.text: Reduce each qualifying product unit by the configured percentage. The discount operates at the individual-unit level.
Tax is calculated on taxable merchandise actually paid after promotion discounts.

assertions.evidence: Completed-order read and payment-processor capture agree.

assertions.description: Tax is calculated on the post-discount merchandise
assertions.message: Tax matches 8.25% of the pre-discount price ($80.00), not of the merchandise actually paid ($60.00).
